blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The entire 2nd District of Ilocos Sur, except the municipalities of Sugpon, Cervantes, and Quirino, will experience a 12-hour scheduled power interruption on Thursday, Nov. 26, to allow for annual preventive maintenance and testing by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP).
